_doc: Self-correcting RAG (descriptive + toy thresholds). CRAG (Yan et al. 2024) runs a lightweight retrieval evaluator that grades each retrieval Correct / Ambiguous / Wrong (toy score thresholds below) and acts: keep, augment with web search, or discard+rewrite. Self-RAG (Asai et al. ICLR 2024) trains the LM to emit REFLECTION TOKENS — Retrieve, IsRel, IsSup, IsUse — that gate whether to retrieve, and to critique relevance / support / usefulness. Thresholds are illustrative, not measured.
_source: _research/gen_l10.py (static, descriptive): toy thresholds; cites CRAG arXiv:2401.15884, Self-RAG arXiv:2310.11511.

actions.wrong: discard, fall back to web search / query rewrite

crag.source: Yan, Gu, Zhu, Ling, Cao & Zhang, 'Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation', arXiv:2401.15884 (2024)

gates.Retrieve: decide whether retrieval is needed for this segment
gates.IsSup: is the generated claim supported by the passage?

selfRag.source: Asai, Wu, Wang, Sil & Hajishirzi, 'Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection', ICLR 2024 (arXiv:2310.11511)
